What you get

Support built to help you scale

Dedicated WhatsApp group

A group with your dedicated POC and priority support, so questions get answered where your team already works.

Weekly 1:1 calls

A standing call with your POC to review calls, tighten prompts and decide what to build next.

Max concurrency of 25

Run parallel and batch calling from day one, with up to 25 calls at once.

Setup and integrations

Hands-on help with agent setup, APIs and the integrations your use case depends on.

Subaccount features

Subaccount features are enabled on your account for the length of the pilot.

Fixed per-minute pricing

A predictable cost per minute with Bolna recommended models, so you can budget before you scale.

How it works

From payment to production in four steps

01

Buy your pilot

Create an account on the platform, open Add Funds, and choose a plan from the Pilots tab.

02

Meet your POC

Your WhatsApp group opens and your first 1:1 call gets booked with your dedicated POC.

03

Build and test

Create your first agent with Auto Build in under 10 minutes, then run test calls and refine.

04

Go live and scale

Run batch calls, review results in your weekly 1:1, and plan what comes after the pilot.
